title: Magnetic Moment Operator
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly write the magnetic moment operator for a nucleus of A nucleons.

title: Isospin Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student should introduce the concept of isospin and explain the isoscalar and isovector operators.

title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the sum of magnetic moments of the two mirror nuclei.

title: Relative Sizes
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss the relative sizes of the isoscalar and isovector operators.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect definitions of the operators or miscalculating the contributions from protons and neutrons.
